subject: How to Remove a User
response:
Hello! To remove a user from the platform entirely, you can deactivate their account. To do this:
1. Click your profile icon in the upper-right corner and select **Admin Panel**.
2. Click your profile icon in the admin panel and select **User Management**.
3. Click the ellipsis (⋯) icon next to the user’s name and select **Deactivate User**.

If you are only trying to remove them from a specific team:
1. Click your profile icon and select **Teams Management**.
2. Go to the **Teams** tab and select the relevant team.
3. Under the **Users** tab, select the delete icon in the **Action** column next to the user.

Alternatively, from the main Users tab in Teams Management, you can click the three-dot icon next to the user's name and select **Remove from Teams** (you will be prompted to transfer ownership of their resources to a new owner). 

Please note that you must have Company Admin or Team Admin access to perform these actions.

issue: I want Claude to stop crawling by website
subject: Website Data crawl
response:
To stop Anthropic from crawling your website, you can block our crawler by modifying the `robots.txt` file in your top-level directory. 

To block the bot from your entire website, add the following lines to your `robots.txt` file:

User-agent: ClaudeBot
Disallow: /

Please make sure to do this for every subdomain you wish to opt out from. We recommend using this method rather than blocking IP addresses, as blocking IPs may impede our ability to read your `robots.txt` file and may not persistently guarantee an opt-out. 

If you only want to limit the crawling activity rather than block it entirely, we also support the non-standard `Crawl-delay` extension (e.g., `Crawl-delay: 1`). 

If you have further questions or believe the bot is malfunctioning, you can reach out to claudebot@anthropic.com from an email address that includes the domain you are contacting us about.

subject: Employee leaving the company
response:
To remove an employee who has left the company and prevent them from accessing the platform, you can lock their user access. This process also allows you to transfer ownership of their resources (such as tests) to another team member.

Here are the steps to lock their access:
1. Log in to your **HackerRank for Work** account.
2. Select your profile icon in the upper-right corner and choose **Teams Management** from the drop-down menu.
3. Go to the **Users** tab and select the user who has left.
4. Click **More** and select **Lock**.
5. In the **Lock Users** dialog, you can select another user under **Transfer to** to transfer their resource ownership.
6. Click **Confirm**.

Alternatively, you can remove them directly from a team by going to the **Teams** tab, selecting the team, navigating to the **Users** tab, and clicking the **delete** icon next to their name. Note that if the user belongs to only one team, removing them from that team will automatically lock their access.

issue: i am a professor in a college and wanted to setup a claude lti key for my students
subject: Claude for students
response:
To set up the Claude LTI integration for your students, you will need administrator access in both your Learning Management System (such as Canvas) and your Claude for Education account. If you do not have these permissions, we recommend contacting your university's IT administrator for assistance.

If you are an administrator using Canvas, you can set up the LTI key by following these steps:

1. Sign in to Canvas as an administrator and navigate to **Admin -> Developer Keys**.
2. Click "+ Developer Key" then "+ LTI Key."
3. Enter the following information:
   - **Key Name:** Claude LTI
   - **Description:** Enter a short description
   - **Redirect URIs:** https://claude.ai/lti/launch
   - **Title:** Claude LTI
   - **Target Link URI:** https://claude.ai/lti/launch
   - **OpenID Connect Initiation Url:** https://claude.ai/api/lti/login
   - **JWK method:** https://claude.ai/api/lti/keys
4. Under **Additional Settings**, toggle Privacy Level to **Public**.
5. Under **Placements**, remove the defaults and add "Course Navigation" and "Assignment Edit".
6. Click "Save" and toggle the state to **On**.

Next, install the app in Canvas:
1. Go to **Admin -> Settings -> Apps**.
2. Click "View App Configurations" then "+ App."
3. Select **Configuration Type** "By Client ID."
4. Input the Client ID generated for your developer key.
5. Click "Install" and refresh the course page.

Finally, enable the integration in Claude:
1. Sign in to Claude for Education as an administrator.
2. Navigate to **Organization settings > Connectors**.
3. Find **Canvas** and click "Enable."
4. Input your Canvas Domain, Client ID, and Deployment ID, then click "Save Changes."
justification: The corpus provides step-by-step instructions for setting up the Claude LTI in Canvas, while noting that it requires administrator privileges.
